messages.content: Build an editable roller assembly centered at the origin in plan, with its horizontal axis along X at 80 cm above ground. The hollow roller is 1 m long, 50 cm outside diameter, with a 14 cm through-bore. A 10 cm diameter shaft, 1.8 m long and centered on the roller, passes through it. Put a separate upright bearing block beyond each roller end, leaving an 8 cm clear gap. Each block is 12 cm thick along X, 42 cm across Z and 1 m tall, with a coaxial 14 cm through-hole. Stand both blocks on a separate 1.8 by 0.7 m base plate, 12 cm thick, on the ground. Keep those five parts independently editable and grouped; preserve the existing samples.

Keep bore diameters, transverse sizes and existing component identities, and leave the other objects alone.
